sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (North Higgins Lake State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483542: /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for the East and 'West, Mini Cabins' maps, 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-04-13, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-10-26)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site: $43 a night for 20/30-amp sites, $48 for 50-amp, $58 for the two East full-hookup sites (2027-05-18, 07-13). West Campground off-season (semi-modern while the shower building is closed): $36 / $41 through mid-April 2027. 2026 in season $41 / $46 / $56. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (North Higgins Lake State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483542: /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for the East and 'West, Mini Cabins' maps, 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-04-13, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-10-26): East fee schedules -32685 (54 sites) $43, -32686 (27) $48, -31491 (2 full hookup) $58 for 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13, $41 / $46 / $56 for 2026-11-17 to 2027-04-13; West -32681 (54) $43 and -32683 (38) $48 in season, $36 / $41 for 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12 and 2027-04-13 + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (North Higgins Lake, East and West Campground: Modern 50 AMP $46, 20/30 AMP $41; West semi-modern 50 AMP $41, 20/30 AMP or toilets $36) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/northhiggins ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/northhiggins (Modern Campground: 'All sites have either 20- and 30-amp or 20-, 30- and 50-amp electrical service'; tags 'Full-hookup sites', 'Some campsites with 50-amp service') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (North Higgins Lake State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483542: /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for the East and 'West, Mini Cabins' maps, 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-04-13, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-10-26) (East: 2 sites 'Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps/50 Amps', 'Water Hookup=Yes', 'Sewer Hookup=Yes'; 67 sites across both loops list 50 amps), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 175 campsites on the booking site, 83 in the East Campground and 92 in the West, besides 2 mini cabins in the West loop and 5 boat-camping sites. Two East sites are full hookup; the rest are electric only. Allowed rig lengths run 20-50 ft (41 sites take 50 ft; 7 East sites only 20 ft). Most sites are generous and shaded by oaks, maples and pines.

sites.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (North Higgins Lake State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483542: /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for the East and 'West, Mini Cabins' maps, 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-04-13, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-10-26) (maps 'East' 83 campsites and 'West, Mini Cabins' 92 campsites + 2 mini cabins, 'Boat Camp' 5; per-site allowed equipment) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/northhiggins ('divided into the east and west loops. Most sites are generous in size and are shaded by oaks, maples and pines'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: West Campground toilet/shower building open May 1 - October 31; the East's is open for its whole reservation season. The two-lane sanitation station toward the East loop is for registered campers only.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/northhiggins (Modern Campground tags 'Toilet & shower building', 'Vault toilet', 'Sanitation station'; 'The park's sanitation station is in the modern campground, toward the east loop. There is potable water available and two lanes. This location is unable to offer sanitation station access to non-registered campers') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (East Campground: modern toilet/shower building 'Available for all reservable season'; West Campground: 'May 1 to Oct. 31'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reservation season by campground: East Campground May 15 - October 14; West Campground year-round. Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (North Higgins Lake / East Campground: reservation season 'May 15' - 'October 14'; West Campground: 'Year-round' - 'Year-round') + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/northhiggins ('For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (North Higgins Lake State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483542: /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for the East and 'West, Mini Cabins' maps, 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-04-13, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-10-26) (175 bookable campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Modern campground in East and West loops along the north shore of Higgins Lake (Michigan's 10th-largest), at the former site of the world's largest seedling nursery; the Higgins Lake Nursery and CCC Museum, a day-use swim beach, boat launch and the Iron Belle Trail are in the park. Roscommon and Grayling are each about 15 minutes away. --Claude
